form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Unique ID of this component on the dashboard, generated when the component is added (e.g. text-input-AB1C2). It cannot be changed.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this component, shown in its tab on the dashboard.

form:FormGroup.label: Key
form:FormGroup.helpText: Parameter name that the entered value is given. Use it in queries and expressions as ${{key}, e.g. a key of user is used as ${{user}.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Parameter name, used in queries as ${{key}.
